stage: Contract committed before runtime implementation. Acceptance of an installed game path remains required.

api.name: scaleProcEffect
api.role: Pure original magnitude fold over the 22 known minimum shapes. Preserve input and nested identities/copy rules; result type retains the effect discriminator and widens numeric values, without promising arbitrary application metadata.

api.name: gainWard
api.role: Borrow {dead,ward}; skip nonpositive/dead requests before querying the rate port; query once, then add to the current pool and return the gain. No clamp, retry, second dead check or hidden state.

api.name: applyWardEffect
api.role: Read maximum life first, compute flat plus percent, then observe the pool; call the gain port only for a positive amount; return whether the pool actually grew. Gain return values do not substitute for reading the resulting pool.

ownership.state: Caller-owned plain actor state; one shared port object can serve many actors. No per-actor wrapper or per-call closure is required.
ownership.content: Trusted typed magnitude fields. Existing ProcContent validates dispatch, not full effect schemas. Serialized content needs its owning validation/compiler boundary.
ownership.host: Actor lookup, native visual cues, event occurrence and durable saves remain explicit host work. Existing ProcRuntime owns rider selection; the game keeps its observable Actor.gainWard and World.fireProcRiders hooks.

ordering: Keep original arithmetic, undefined own keys and the unscaled identity path, including zero/negative/NaN power.
Positive scaling preserves damage/cast metadata via shallow copies; healAllies copies only base and perLevel. Unknown runtime tags pass through unchanged without implying executable support.
Maximum-life callbacks occur before the ward effect captures its before-value. Resource-rate callbacks occur after admission but before the pool read/addition.
Synchronous nested calls have independent locals; callbacks may alter the current pool. Exceptions propagate with already committed state preserved and no automatic retry.
Cues run only after observed growth, then riders in original order. A thrown gain/cue skips the remaining tail.
acceptance: Original magnitude, metadata and resource fixtures unchanged through the SDK and installed game.
Typed and JavaScript packed consumers; no ambient host APIs or randomness.
Independent arithmetic, guard/read-order, identity, nested and exception assertions.
Fresh game candidate; earlier controls and all predecessor runtime files preserved.
Real frame-to-ward-to-HUD path and prior integration regressions.
Measured receipts and bounded module costs; device claims require target-device runs.
remaining: The other 21 executor branches, delayed queue semantics and broader resource effects.
Effect-schema/content validation beyond the existing dispatch content compiler.
Complete native-engine packages and target-device performance.
